style: Shaded gold pixel-art gear with charcoal medallion
generation: Built-in image_gen tool; original brand icon and wordmark supplied as references.
basePrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: individual NPC role logo for NPC Workshop.
Reference image 1 is the approved existing brand icon; reference image 2 is the approved wordmark. Use both as STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets.
Create ONE square transparent-background role emblem. Match the approved shaded pixel-art gold gear badge: chunky stepped square pixels, dark charcoal near-black outlines, warm golden bevels and highlights at top left, ochre shadows bottom right, charcoal circular inner medallion. Keep outer gear shape, proportion, pixel scale and palette very close to reference 1. Replace central N with the specified role pictogram, large and readable, centered within the dark medallion. Simple deliberate silhouette, limited details. No letters, words, captions, watermarks, background scene, extra border, or decorative particles. Entire gear visible with 6% transparent padding. Crisp hard pixel edges, no blur or smooth vector curves. Gold is dominant; pictogram may use small steel, warm wood, cream highlights when needed. Output 1024x1024 PNG with real alpha.
